name: internal-rotation-cable
title: Internal Rotation: Cable
primer: This is an exercise for shoulder and biceps strengthening.
steps: Sit on the floor with your body close to a low cable pulley.
Grasp the pulley with your left arm and position your elbow bent at a 90 degree angle.
Pull the cable towards your body and internally rotate your shoulder until your forearm is across your abs.
tips: Ensure your back is straight throughout the exercise.
